name: KNUFFI
detailed_description:
Knuffi is a 2D pixel art platformer inspired by other well-known video games. Jump into the simulation and help Knuffi find a way out of it and uncover the truth.

What to Expect


Handcrafted Levels: Run through ?? handcrafted levels; each one introduces a new challenge and new obstacles to master.

Music: Listen to the music that is mostly specifically made for Knuffi.

Storyline: Help Knuffi break free from the simulation and unveil the secrets behind her digital imprisonment.

Fluid Gameplay and Moveset: With Knuffi's simple but useful abilities, such as running, jumping, sprinting, dashing and bouncing around like a ball, you can easily traverse through the levels with ease.

Made for Casual gamers and Speedrunners: Thanks to Knuffi's moveset, it's easy to learn and easy to master. With the built-in timer, speedrunners can easily compare their times.

Handmade Sprites: Most sprites and graphics are handmade and won't feature anything made by AI. The whole game is AI-free!

The Future


Update with Challenges: Stay tuned; I plan on adding challenges via updates after the game is released.

My Intentions


I started creating games almost 10 years ago, but I have never finished creating a game before. My goal is to finally create a game that isn't expensive but will be fun and enjoyable to play. Knuffi has been in development for over 2 years now, and I still don't want to give up. I'm trying to deliver the best game I can create as a solo developer.

Have fun playing!

short_description: Explore digital world with a cute cat-girl named "Knuffi" in this cute but exciting 2D pixelart platformer. Navigate through a variety of levels, each offering unique challenges. An adorable adventure awaits!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Capable of running OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD HD Graphics (Capable of running Vulkan)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vukan is used for the usage of glow
